fields.label: Rail ID
fields.description: Stable key for this rail, e.g. 'featured'. Used by the storefront for React keys and analytics — renaming it is a new rail, not a rename.

fields.label: Category Slug
fields.description: Which category this rail pulls from, e.g. 'personal-care'. Must match a slug from list_categories — a slug nothing matches renders an empty rail, which the storefront hides entirely.

fields.label: Products To Show
fields.description: The desktop grid is 5 columns — more than 5 wraps onto a second row rather than scrolling.

fields.label: Heading Size
fields.description: lg = hero-sized heading, used for the first/featured rail
